metadata.description: Research-first and change-safety skills for Claude.

plugins.name: design-research
plugins.description: Research how real products built a screen (GitHub code, UI galleries, Mobbin, Dribbble) before mocking it.

plugins.name: backend-research
plugins.description: Research how competitors and open-source apps modelled a backend feature before designing it.

plugins.name: prior-art
plugins.description: Decide deliberately whether to use, copy or build a subsystem, after finding who already solved it.

plugins.name: blast-radius
plugins.description: Work out everything a change can break before making it: callers, policies, generated types, other apps, old clients.

plugins.name: blind-audit
plugins.description: Audit a subsystem against the promise its users were given, writing assertions before reading the code.

plugins.name: refactor
plugins.description: Change the shape of existing code without changing what it does: extract, rename, move, split, deduplicate.

plugins.name: screen-review
plugins.description: Run the real app, screenshot the UI you changed, and check it against the repo's reference screens.

plugins.name: match-the-app
plugins.description: Read the code of the app's existing pages before writing a new one, or open a design canvas when nothing is like it.

plugins.name: product-video
plugins.description: Promo videos and App Store previews of your own apps: gather and study references, propose a storyboard, wireframe it, then build from real recordings in Remotion.
